fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' fires a void bolt in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory as it travels, deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, applies {{as|2 Plasma|buzzword}}, and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} them for 4 seconds.
fields.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires {{sti|{{as|100 ability power}}}} from [[items]] to upgrade – ''Void Seeker'' applies {{as|3 Plasma|buzzword}} instead and refunds 75% of its {{sti|cooldown}} if it hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
